items.title: How to Test AI Workflows: Simple Evals in Python
items.summary: 该文章介绍了如何用 Python 构建 AI 工作流的简易评估框架（evals.py），通过运行示例案例、执行柔性属性检查（如限制词数、禁止特定承诺）并重复测试，以计算通过率而非传统的单次精确匹配结果。核心方法借鉴了 Anthropic 的评估标准，将测试分为代码规则、人工审查和 AI 裁判三类，强调在无法使用精确断言时，利用通过率统计来量化提示词改进的有效性，从而解决 LLM 输出不稳定带来的测试难题。
items.summary_en: The article introduces a Python-based evaluation harness to test non-deterministic AI workflows by running repeated test cases and checking properties rather than exact matches, using a stand-in assistant for offline development. It outlines three grading methods—code-based rules, human review, and AI judges—and provides concrete success criteria, such as enforcing a 60-word limit or ensuring order numbers are mentioned, to measure pass rates reliably.

items.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
items.summary: Sphinx 是一款开源的 Git Hook 工具，在 AI 代理提交的代码推送前通过质询开发者验证其对代码异常处理逻辑的理解，支持 Codex、Claude Code 等主流代理及 OpenAI 兼容接口。其核心机制是审查 Diff 并模拟 Stripe 扣款重试等故障场景，答错需学习后重试，答对方可放行，同时严格保护 .env 文件安全，并提供 `sphinx yolo` 模式允许跳过检查但记录日志。
items.why_now: 该开源工具免费上架，即刻拦截AI代码风险，抢在竞品前建立代码审查壁垒。
items.summary_en: Sphinx is a free, open-source Git hook that quizzes developers on edge-case scenarios in their AI-generated code before allowing a push, ensuring understanding of logic like duplicate event handling or failure states. It integrates with agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor by reading diffs via OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible endpoints, using minimal tokens and a strict privacy model where answers never reach the coding agent. The tool supports a `sphinx yolo` bypass for urgent pushes, logs all skipped checks, and requires Node 22.19+ on macOS, Linux, or WSL.

items.title: Show HN: Rubi – A knowledge graph that cuts how much Claude Code re-reads
items.summary: Rubi 是一款基于 MCP 协议和纯 Markdown 的本地 AI 编码智能体知识图谱工具，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 IDE，通过结合 PageRank 代码地图与混合检索技术（BM25、PPR、RRF）实现上下文的高效召回。基于 284 份真实转录记录的分析显示，传统长会话中 71% 的成本源于重复读取上下文，Rubi 通过早期压缩、会话交接及自动知识召回机制，在解决长会话“负重”问题的同时，显著减少了模型在每次交互中的 Token 消耗。
items.why_now: 针对 Claude Code 71% 成本源于重复读取的痛点，Rubi 现免费开源提供 MCP 支持。
items.summary_en: Rubi is an MCP-based knowledge graph and context manager that reduces token costs by compacting long sessions and mapping code relationships using PageRank and hybrid retrieval (BM25 and Reciprocal Rank Fusion). Analysis of 284 Claude Code transcripts revealed that 71% of costs stem from re-reading context, a problem Rubi addresses by storing plain markdown in a local .rubi/ directory with zero dependencies. This tool integrates with agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to automatically restore relevant knowledge before each request.

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
items.summary: HybridAgents 架构通过轻量级 HybridLink 和连续工作记忆实现潜空间思考与文本交互的动态融合，配合 HybridSFT 和 HybridRL 后训练算法，在保持工具调用能力的前提下解决了潜空间推理的透明性与可访问性难题。在涵盖数学、科学、医学及智能体推理的 11 个基准测试中，该方法相比前沿 LLM 智能体性能提升 10.4%，同时实现 35.5%-54.7% 的 token 压缩、1.8x-2.6x 的推理加速以及 2.7x-3.7x 的成本降低。
items.why_now: 代码数据已开源，且推理成本直降2.7-3.7倍
items.summary_en: Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents) integrate latent space thinking with text-based tool interaction via a lightweight HybridLink and continuous working memory, supported by dedicated HybridSFT and HybridRL post-training algorithms. Evaluated across three model scales on 11 benchmarks in math, science, medicine, and agentic tasks, HybridAgents outperform frontier LLM agents by 10.4% while reducing token usage by 35.5%-54.7%, accelerating inference by 1.8x-2.6x, and lowering costs by 2.7x-3.7x.

items.title: Get a desktop ping when Claude Code is waiting on you, with a Notification hook
items.summary: 该方案利用 Claude Code 的 Notification hook 机制，在权限请求或等待输入时触发 .claude/hooks/notify.sh 脚本，通过解析 stdin 中的 JSON message 字段实现跨平台桌面通知（macOS 使用 osascript，Linux 使用 notify-send，兜底使用终端响铃）。配置需在 .claude/settings.json 中注册该 command 类型 hook，并配合 allow-list 过滤，仅对关键决策进行提醒，确保会话不被阻断。
items.why_now_en: Claude Code's new Notification hook API just shipped.
items.summary_en: Claude Code’s Notification hook triggers when the agent needs user input, delivering a JSON payload via stdin to a custom script saved at `.claude/hooks/notify.sh` and registered in `.claude/settings.json`. The script uses `osascript` on macOS or `notify-send` on Linux to display a desktop notification with the pending message, falling back to a terminal bell if neither tool is available. Users must ensure the hook always exits with code 0 to prevent session blocking and should pair it with a permission allow-list to avoid excessive notifications for routine commands.

items.title: anomalyco/opencode
items.summary: OpenCode 是由 AnomalyCo 开发的开源 AI 编程智能体，支持通过 Homebrew、npm 等工具在 macOS、Linux 及 Windows 上一键安装，并提供处于测试阶段的桌面应用程序。其核心功能包含内置的 build（全权限开发）与 plan（只读分析）双智能体模式，允许用户通过 Tab 键切换以应对不同任务，同时支持通过 @general 调用子代理处理复杂搜索任务。
items.why_now: OpenCode 桌面应用刚进 BETA，开源替代方案功能完整，宜即刻评估部署。
items.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent developed by Anomaly, installable via package managers like npm, brew, and scoop, with a beta desktop app supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux. The tool features two built-in agents: a "build" agent for full-access development and a read-only "plan" agent for code exploration, complemented by a "general" subagent for complex multi-step searches.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.summary: VoiceStudio 是一款开源的 ElevenLabs 本地替代品，支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、视频配音、听写及有声书创作，核心功能由 k2-fsa/OmniVoice 引擎驱动。该项目提供 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的一键安装脚本，支持 NVIDIA CUDA、Apple Metal 加速及纯 CPU 运行，并内置本地 API 和 MCP 接口以连接 AI 代理。
items.why_now: 开源本地语音克隆替代 ElevenLabs，覆盖646语言，免费且数据不出本地。
items.why_now_en: Free local voice cloning replaces ElevenLabs for solo builders
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local ElevenLabs alternative that supports voice cloning, design, video dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. The Electron-based desktop application uses the k2-fsa/OmniVoice engine by default and offers hardware-specific acceleration via CUDA for NVIDIA GPUs or Metal/MPS for Apple Silicon, with a CPU-only mode requiring approximately 5 GB of disk space. Installation is available via a one-command script for macOS and Linux or PowerShell for Windows, and the tool integrates with local APIs and MCP for agent workflows.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: XERJ 是一款本地 AI 搜索工具，通过自动索引代码、文档及 PDF，比传统的 grep 减少 40 倍的 Token 消耗，并可将基础设施成本降低 10 倍。在参考编程场景下，它能将编码智能体的输出 Token 降低 2.7 倍，同时将解决率维持在 16/16，相比纯内存模式不仅大幅降低成本，还提升了代码生成效率。
items.why_now: XERJ 刚开源替代 grep，实测省 40 倍 token，现有一键安装 MCP 接入 Claude/Cursor 的窗口期。
items.why_now_en: New API cuts agent token costs 2.7x.
items.summary_en: XERJ is a local AI search tool that automatically indexes code, docs, and logs to reduce token usage by 40x compared to grep and cut infrastructure costs by 10x versus Elasticsearch. In controlled tests, integrating XERJ for reference coding reduced a coding agent's output tokens by 2.7x while maintaining a 16/16 solve rate, allowing smaller, cheaper models to outperform pricier alternatives. The tool supports a one-command install for agent integration and requires users to contribute a single field report as a condition for its free, Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
items.summary: DeepSeek 推出基于自研搜索引擎的 Search 与 Fetch API，分别用于检索网页并返回结构化结果、抓取单页并转为 Markdown，基础请求单价为每 1000 次成功请求 0.75 美元，仅对返回 HTTP 200 且非空结果的请求计费。该 API 支持 `site:`、`lang:` 等查询操作符，采用 Bearer 认证并兼容 OpenAI 错误格式，通过 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 或 Codex 调用时目前免费，独立调用计费将于北京时间 0 点开启。
items.why_now: DeepSeek API 搜索抓取功能计费窗口即将开启，独立开发者可低价接入实时联网能力构建 Agent。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has launched Search and Fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests, leveraging its in-house search engine to provide live web access for agents and RAG applications. The Search API returns structured JSON results with advanced query operators, while the Fetch API retrieves specific web pages as Markdown, both utilizing standard bearer authentication via the https://api.deepseek.com endpoint. Notably, server-side tool calls executed through DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, or Codex currently access these features for free, with per-request billing initiating on January 1, 2025.

items.title: AI Agents Conquer Minecraft and ML Engineering: October 19 Roundup
items.summary: 四个Gemini 4 Argon智能体利用Mineflayer库在沙盒环境中首次实现了端到端自主击败Minecraft末影龙，耗时27小时14分钟并生成了2783个程序。MLExpert作为35B参数混合专家模型，通过层级智能体监督微调将MLE-Bench Lite的平均奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%，性能比肩Kimi-K3等前沿模型。Anthropic推出Claude Haiku 5.5及升级后的Sonnet/Opus 5.5系列，其中Sonnet 5.5较前代提速30%且成本降低，Opus 5.5运行成本降低40%。
items.why_now: Anthropic十月7日发Claude Haiku 5.5，降价加速独立开发者规模化部署。
items.why_now_en: DeepSeek's new V4.1 API cuts costs for indie devs.
items.summary_en: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents achieved the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft's Ender Dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes by writing 2,783 programs via the Mineflayer library without human intervention. Meanwhile, the 35B MoE model MLExpert improved average medal rates on MLE-Bench Lite from 37.9% to 72.7%, matching frontier model performance through hierarchical agentic fine-tuning and windowed interaction RL. Anthropic also launched cost-optimized Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume work, alongside Claude Sonnet 5.5 (30% faster and cheaper) and Opus 5.5 (40% less expensive to run).

Inside the black box of AI: How AI models actually think | Emmanuel Ameisen (Anthropic)
items.summary_en: Anthropic interpretability researcher Emmanuel Ameisen reveals that LLMs like Claude do not merely predict the next token but actively form general concept representations and plan multiple tokens ahead without explicit articulation. His findings indicate that models exhibit structural similarities to human conscious versus unconscious processing, suggesting that anthropomorphizing AI is a valid approach and that capabilities emerge through smooth scaling curves rather than sudden jumps.

directions.description_en: A lightweight local context compressor for AI coding assistants that trims redundant tokens via a real-time Markdown knowledge graph.
directions.target_user: 使用 Claude Code 或 Cursor 进行长会话开发的独立开发者。
directions.target_user_en: Solo developers using Claude Code or Cursor for long-session development.

MCP 协议集成实现自动上下文召回
会话交接时的关键信息压缩
core_features_en: MCP protocol integration for auto context recall
Key information compression during session handoff

directions.why_now_en: Hacker News discussions highlight that 71% of traditional AI coding session costs stem from redundant reads, with the Rubi project validating this pain point; MCP being a hot topic across 3 sources indicates developers urgently need standardized local context management to tackle high Token costs.

directions.monetization_en: Freemium model: Basic compression is free; advanced knowledge graph visualization and multi-project support are paid.
